subject: STABLE: bridge batch capacity (bridge.c/.h/test fea01019 72946c2e 7d683b91 ) - gates GREEN; HEAVY RELEASE
body: Gates on the shared tree (721bc00 + uncommitted A/B-schedule work of others + mine): run_host_tests all PASS through the known final NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN probe (55 PASS lines incl. render-pass batching / pre-frame / async / command-block pool); integration --candidate 1005 checks, only the known CA natural-stride oracle (66/42); render harness PASS; CA host test 41 checks ASan+release PASS with preframe 0 (rerun: first attempt hit a mid-edit tegu_perf_note signature in compute_frontend.m, not mine) and 1; iOS -Werror syntax bridge (both preframe defaults) + compute_frontend.m (base and inert/compositor/batch variants). Default behaviour unchanged (cap 32). Mine to commit: gpu/metal/nord2_metal_bridge.c, .h, gpu/tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c (capacity hunks only; the cmdpool parts there are encode's step 10). Analysis tools (build dir, not product): gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/fsjobs/{fsjobs.py,model_table.py,summ.py,patch-cap-*.json}. Next device A/B candidates in order: (1) -DTEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT + compositor tile hunk (biggest: FS jobs 24->2 medium, 40->3 large), (2) NORD2_METAL_PREFRAME=1, (3) NORD2_METAL_BATCH_MAX=128 + compositor cap 3-liner.
